areas.t: Yesterday, widespread rain showers effectively cleansed the atmosphere of pollutants, but particulate matter will accumulate through the coming week.  Moisture from fog and haze will contribute to the mass of fine particulate matter today.  Tomorrow, an upper-level disturbance will traverse Texas fr
